{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Shroom 1.jpg|thumb|A mushroom.]]
'''Fungus''' (plural form: '''fungi'''), collectively referred to as '''funga''', was a distinctive group of organisms found on countless [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Fungi organism consisted of an expansive underground structure called ''mycelium'',<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Several levels of a "Mycelial Immunity" ability, part of the mitigation in [[Sporefall]]}}</ref> and visible fruiting bodies known as ''mushrooms'', which were considered a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] by many species. Creatures with at least partially fungivorous diet included [[Barbed ginx]]<ref name="fascinating">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Fascinating!|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> and [[Geo Beast|Geo best]] [[Larva/Legends|larvae]].<ref name="fungal protection" /> Many mushrooms, however, were [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]], such as those of the [[blood-eating fungus]].<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
[[File:DagobahMushroomSpore-TVE.png|thumb|Spores.|left]]
Mushrooms, the easiest part of fungi to spot, came in a variety of shapes and [[Color/Legends|colors]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> sometimes being luminescent.<ref name="The Hive">''[[The Hive]]''</ref><ref name="TOR" /> However, visually identical mushrooms could belong to fungi of completely different [[Species/Legends|species]], such as in the instance of the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooinian]] [[Glowshroom]] and a separate [[Ancient Dantooinian fungi|unnamed species of Dantooinian fungi]].<ref name="fungal protection">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Fungal Protection|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> Mushrooms could grow from the ground, or from the rocks and the [[Plant/Legends|plants]], such as from [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="TOR" /> 

Fungi reproduced via spores - a microscopic stage of fungus' life cycle which spread through the air. High concentration of spores in the breathing air could severely affect animals, causing a wide range of side-effects from slight dizziness to mental disorders and [[Death/Legends|death]],<ref name="sporefall">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Sporefall]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> however some spores could have a positive, healing effect.<ref name="Blood Hunt">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=flashpoint|Blood Hunt}}</ref>

==Study of fungi==
[[File:BioEngeneeredFungus.png|thumb|Fungus bioengineered by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].]]
The branch of [[xenobiology]] studying fungi was called ''mycology''.<ref name="fungal protection" /> Scientists of the galaxy were fascinated by fungi in a variety of ways. During the [[Seizure of CZ-198|seizure]] of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]'s research moon [[CZ-198]], ''bioengineered fungus'' was among the assets found in the facility.<ref name="czerka">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=other|"Bioengineered Fungus", a bioanalysis crew-skill object, found on [[CZ-198]]}}</ref>

Researchers associated with the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] had a unique opportunity to study fungi and its relation with animals, when a highly advanced [[Research vessel|research-vessel]] [[Jannimak]], hosting a vast number of exotic organisms, [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashed]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> When the ship's systems, designed to accommodate the life forms onboard, terraformed an area surrounding the crash,<ref name="wreckage">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Wreckage on Dantooine|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> a [[Sporefall|unique ecosystem]] emerged, showcasing the effects fungi can have on sentients and other animals,<ref name="sporefall" /> as well as how symbiotic relations are formed between creatures due to the fungi influence.<ref name="fascinating" />
== Notable examples ==
* Fungi from [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] were rainbow-colored.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>
* Fungi on the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] world of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] were capable of movement on [[bora]]s in order to search sunlight.<ref name="Reunion">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>
* The [[Grenade fungi/Legends|Grenade fungi]] were white, globular fungi found on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. When stepped on they exploded in a cloud of poisonous spores.<ref>''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'' </ref>
* [[Lokka Fungus|Lokka Fungi]] were used in [[Totem magic|Totem Magic]] on [[Endor]]<ref name="Episode">{{Ewoks|Sunstar vs. Shadowstone}}</ref><ref>[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref>
